svg.text: Mode: D pent. minor / D mixolydian
Intro → Verse 1 → Chorus → Verse 2 → Chorus → Solo → Outro
Main riff: D – Cadd9 – G ( × 4 per verse )
Chorus: D – C – G then A – G ( V pivot ) → D
Oh, slipped right from my hand
A pivot on "won't bring you back"
Blue on black, tears on a river,
Joker on jack, match on a fire,
Won't bring you back — Blue on black
Safe: D E F# G A C
blue on black · kenny wayne shepherd
